game.title: Batman: Arkham Asylum Game of the Year Edition
game.blurb: Stealth and combat action-adventure set on Arkham Island, from Rocksteady Studios (PC and Mac edition by Feral Interactive), released 2010-03-26 (original game 2009). RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, Platformer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Killer Croc, Poison Ivy and the Joker

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 35140)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Batman:_Arkham_Asylum
Fandom (arkhamcity.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://arkhamcity.fandom.com/wiki/Batman:_Arkham_Asylum
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Batman: Arkham Asylum" (completion stage 2). Its contents list four walkthrough pages, "Intensive Treatment" (about 9,800 characters), "Arkham Island" (about 2,900), "Medical Facility" (about 7,000) and "Dead Man's Point" (about 10,200), all written, plus "Riddler's Challenge", "Combat", "Gadgets and upgrades" and "Achievements and trophies"; "Challenge Mode" and "Downloadable content" are linked but not created. The four walkthrough pages may not cover the whole story, so the guide was not used for structure; it is a candidate for a CC BY-SA route if someone checks it. arkhamcity.fandom.com answers the API under "Batman: Arkham Asylum", with about 173 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 47 Steam achievements is hidden. "Double Trouble" (two Titan henchmen at once, 38%) and "Party Pooper" (the party, 20%) were placed in the late story chapter by name and Steam order; that is a judgement call. "Big Bang", "Bigger Bang" and "Biggest Bang" are the same Joker fight on Easy, Normal and Hard and sit with the late story.
